question.problem:
Consider the system

$$
\{\begin{aligned}-{x}_{1}+2{x}_{3}=2 \\ {x}_{2}-3{x}_{3}=1 \\ 2{x}_{1}-4{x}_{3}=-4.\end{aligned}
$$

Use the standard method of Gaussian elimination to reduce the augmented matrix $M$ of the system to row echelon form.
question.worked_solution:
The augmented matrix for the system is

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 & 2 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & -3 & 1 \\ 2 & 0 & -4 & -4\end{aligned}].
$$

Reducing $M$ to echelon form, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}M & ∼[\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 & 2 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & -3 & 1 \\ 2 & 0 & -4 & -4\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & :=-{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & -2 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & -3 & 1 \\ 2 & 0 & -4 & -4\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-2){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & -2 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & -3 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
